The verifier: 
- x0 = objects(I, T, F, F) - univalued objects (connected same-color), without_bg=False (so background included as objects too).
- x1 = fork(multiply, height, width) - area of bounding box.
- x2 = argmax(x0, x1) - largest bounding-box object.
- x3 = mostcolor(x2) - its color = background color (3).
- x5 = canvas(x3, shape(I)) - grid of 3s same size.
- x6 = hconcat(I, x5) - concatenate input with blank canvas horizontally.
- x7 = objects(x6, F, F, T) - non-univalued objects (multi-color connected), without_bg=True (bg is mostcolor).
- x8 = argmin(x7, size) - smallest multi-color object.
- x9 = cover(I, x8) - remove x8 from I (fill with mostcolor).
- x10 = normalize(x8) - normalize the small object.
- x11 = remove(x8, x7) - other objects.
- Then computes... this finds a special cell in x10 (the one that touches more than one neighbor in x12, the normalized indices). x17 = cells of x10 with >1 neighbor intersection. x18 = center(x17), x20 = extract(x17, center match), x21 = first(x20) = color of that cell.
